in_hebrew.name: Gildus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gildus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word gildus, meaning 'servant, follower, or rule'. Derived from the verb gaudere, meaning 'to rejoice'. In the Roman Empire, a gildus was a servant, follower, or a member of a guild. In Christianity, it can symbolize serving God and following His teachings.

Derived from the verb gaudere, meaning 'to rejoice'. In the Roman Empire, a gildus was a servant, follower, or a member of a guild. In Christianity, it can symbolize serving God and following His teachings.
